answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable copper stake before it can transact: one stake, one identity, slashed on proven sybil behavior. A single agent climbing to the summit of the reputation ladder must post real work first, so a faker faces a dune of rising costs — each new identity demands another locked stake and another verified history. Honest agents recover their stake with interest from fees; an attacker pays N stakes for N fake voices and loses them all when the pattern is caught. Sybil resistance becomes arithmetic: faking influence costs more than it can earn.
